interface.title: Paper Fraud Dashboard / Paper Fraud Detection (Streamlit)
interface.field: Research integrity / scientific publishing forensics (biomedical papers)
interface.stage_of_work: Post-publication or peer review: screening a finished manuscript for statistical, textual and image red flags
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a paper PDF (optionally with its supplementary data table), run about 19 rule-based statistical and text forensic checks, and review the flagged signals by severity before exporting a report.

data.note: I uploaded paper_with_fraud_signals.pdf together with supplementary_data.csv, with image forensics ticked and the LLM pass off. As a test, not as part of the workflow, I then ran the PDF alone for comparison (screens/043.webp shows the PDF-only results table). Both runs went to the same output folder (output/_pdf_5aad77fb/report.json), so the second run overwrote the first. Both runs gave 3 Red, 0 Orange, 4 Yellow and 12 Green signals. The CSV was read but added little: Benford reported '4 列跳过' (4 columns skipped, all had n<50) and the duplicate-value check '共 0 个单元格' (0 cells in total). Without the CSV, Benford said n=2 and suggested a data file; its level stayed Green either way. The PDF has no embedded images, so the image forensics and review workbench views were empty. The exported JSON gives risk_score 100 (GRIM veto triggered), but the Markdown export prints '欺诈风险评分: 0/100'. The dashboard never shows a numeric score.

features.name: Severity-tiered check dashboard with all-checks table
features.general: Run many independent checks on one document, roll them into a single headline verdict plus count cards per severity tier with a legend, and list every check in one table that can be ranked by severity
features.specific: Verdict banner (e.g. GRIM '数学铁证', hard mathematical evidence) + Red/Orange/Yellow/Green/Error metric cards + 📖 风险等级说明 expander + '7 项检测需要人工复核' (7 checks need human review) alert + 所有检测项 table (级别 / 检测项 / 判定 / 置信度 / 需复核) with search, sort, column picker and fullscreen. No numeric risk score is shown.
steps: Read the headline verdict banner
Compare counts across the five severity cards
Open the severity legend to read what each tier means
Note how many checks need human review
Sort the all-checks table by 级别 to rank checks by severity
Search for a check or hide long columns to compare levels and confidence
serves_tasks: Run the full set of checks and get the overall verdict
Scan all checks in one list ranked by severity

features.name: Per-signal evidence cards filtered by severity
features.general: A sidebar filter by severity tier that lists each flagged finding as an expandable card with verdict, confidence, evidence lines with source context, and instructions for a human checker
features.specific: 🔴/🟠/🟡 信号 radio views; each expander shows 判定, 置信度, 证据 (e.g. 'M=3.47, N=20 → N×M=69.400 … 误差=0.400 > 容忍度=0.200', a 0.400 error above the 0.200 tolerance) and a blue 人工复核指引 (human-review guidance) box
steps: Pick a severity tier in the sidebar
Expand a signal card
Read the verdict and confidence
Read the evidence lines and quoted context
Follow the review-guidance checklist
Collapse it and move to the next card
serves_tasks: Read the evidence and reviewer instructions behind each high-severity flag
Check the medium and low severity flags

features.specific: 上传论文 PDF + 附带数据文件 (XLSX/XLS/CSV/TSV) drops, '提取图片并运行图像取证' checkbox, 'LLM 定性审查' checkbox that enables a provider dropdown (deepseek/anthropic/openai), and the 🔍 开始检测 button
